Fantasy World Sim — test build
==============================

Start it
--------
Windows:  double-click fantasy-world-sim.exe
          (If SmartScreen warns "unrecognized app": More info -> Run anyway.
          The build isn't code-signed.)
macOS:    right-click fantasy-world-sim -> Open -> Open
          (Needed the first time only, because the build isn't signed.
          If macOS still refuses, run in Terminal, inside this folder:
            xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine .
          then try again.)
Linux:    ./fantasy-world-sim

Keep the "packs" folder next to the program: it holds the game's content.

Controls
--------
  Right- or middle-drag, WASD   turn the globe (or pan the map)
  Mouse wheel, + / -            zoom
  G                             globe / flat map
  Home                          recentre
  Left click                    use tool (inspect, or paint)
  I / B                         inspect tool / paint tool
  [ / ]                         brush size
  Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y undo / redo
  Esc                           menu (save, load, new world, quit)
  Ctrl+S                        quick-save
  M                             cycle map views
  Space, 1-5                    pause, speed

The World panel on the right generates new worlds: try Planet size,
Continents, Detail, Sea level, Temperature, Rainfall, Mountains, Erosion,
Inland seas and the plate settings, then "Regenerate world". In the Plates
map view, select a hex to see its plate; you can set the plate's heading
and speed by hand and Apply to regenerate the world with that motion.

The Esc menu saves, loads and deletes saved worlds, and asks before
throwing away unsaved changes. Saves are kept in
your user data folder, in fantasy-world-sim/saves:
  Windows:  %APPDATA%\fantasy-world-sim\saves
  macOS:    ~/Library/Application Support/fantasy-world-sim/saves
  Linux:    ~/.local/share/fantasy-world-sim/saves

See CHANGELOG.md for what's new.

Found a bug? Note the seed (shown in the World panel) and what you did.
